purpose: Read-only verification and packaging of the frozen D1-D14 STATS19 analysis.

runtime.note: D15 audit does not refit models; the cap documents the frozen D10-D11 execution setting.

frozen_data_contract.metadata_policy: Metadata and target columns are excluded by the frozen allowlist and never selected by exclusion logic.
frozen_data_contract.2024_embargo: The 2024 rows are test-only for the temporal protocol and are never used for fitting, tuning, preprocessing or threshold choice.

frozen_model_contract.ordered_logit_scope: Matched 100000-row sensitivity baseline; not a full-data primary model.
frozen_model_contract.prediction_rule: Argmax over the three class probabilities

frozen_reporting_boundaries.H1: Metric-dependent generalization gap; no uniform random-split optimism claim.
frozen_reporting_boundaries.H2: LightGBM improves some metrics but has a fatal-recall trade-off; no uniform superiority claim.
frozen_reporting_boundaries.H3: SHAP rank change is quantified descriptively; no binary instability or causal claim.
frozen_reporting_boundaries.regional_holdout: Not executed because no police-force combination was frozen before outcomes were known; spatial generalization is unverified.
frozen_reporting_boundaries.2020_sensitivity: Re-train on 2018-2019 and 2021-2022, validate on 2023 and test on the same 2024 cohort; it is not a causal pandemic analysis.
